thread:
Jordan: FYI Acme (org acme-123) reports 403s on /v1/generate right after an SSO key rotation. Embeddings are intermittently 403 as well; rerank failing. Customer request id req-0a1b2c. Can someone take a look?

Maria: Thanks — can you paste the exact error body and confirm whether this is an SSO-provisioned service key or an org/admin token?

Jordan: Error body:
```
{"error":{"code":403,"message":"missing scope: inference.generate","request_id":"req-0a1b2c"}}
```
Looks like an SSO-provisioned service key (Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx). Customer UI shows key with embeddings scope but no generation scope.

Oliver: That symptom reminds me of a CSV parsing edge-case — sometimes a trailing comma in the scopes list causes an empty token and downstream mapping can drop a scope. @Devon can you check the provisioner rotation logs for acme-123?

Devon: On it. Jordan — can you run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/self` and paste the response (masking sensitive values)? Also confirm this is prod.

Jordan: Prod. Customer returned:
```
{"id":"key_abc123","scopes":["embeddings.read","rerank.run"],"org_id":"acme-123"}
```
So inference.generate is absent.

infra-bot: provisioner: rotated keys for org acme-123 at 2025-03-16T10:12:34Z (provisioner v2.3.1)

Devon: Checking rotation job logs — found `scopes_csv="embeddings.read,rerank.run, "` with a trailing comma. Our CSV->array routine in that version didn't trim/filter empty strings; index alignment shifted and dropped inference.generate. I'll open a PR to fix: trim tokens, filter empties, validate required scopes for SSO flows.

Devon: Immediate mitigation: reprovision a key with explicit scopes via admin API. Example to create a full-scoped service key:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"acme-rotated-fix","scopes":["inference.generate","embeddings.read","rerank.run"],"org_id":"acme-123"}'
```
Propagation should be ~30s.

Maria: Can we reproduce the bug in staging before we tell the customer? They need a short-term unblock.

Devon: Repro is trivial. Workaround for production: PATCH the existing key or create a new one. Note: for SSO-managed rotation keys, the provisioner will re-roll keys; safest short-term is to reprovision via admin API and coordinate with the customer to switch. If you want me to run a one-off patch I can do that:
```
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/key_abc123 \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"scopes":["inference.generate","embeddings.read","rerank.run"]}'
```

Jordan: Customer created the new admin key per your create snippet and confirms /v1/generate now returns 200. Embeddings and rerank calls returning OK. They want RCA and ETA for a permanent fix.

Devon: Root cause summary: trailing comma in scopes CSV from SSO rotation produced an empty token; parser didn't drop empties, resulting in misaligned mapping that omitted inference.generate. Fix is in review (trim+filter+validation). ETA: ~48h (PR + CI + canary deploy). I'll post updates here and in #eng-runtime.

Maria: Thanks — I'll close the customer loop, offer the reprovision as remediation, and open a short postmortem after the fix is deployed. :white_check_mark: Acme Admin — sorry for the disruption, please reach out if anything else looks off.
